purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: China Domestic Balance Sheet External Transmission
question: Explain system: China Domestic Balance Sheet External Transmission?
bluf: A balance-sheet chain: property correction -> household wealth/confidence and developer cash flow fall -> high saving -> weaker land revenue and LGFV capacity -> low demand and low inflation with strong industrial supply -> real depreciation and excess output support exports -> surpluses and partner trade defenses -> Beijing weights export access, supply-chain security, self-reliance and managed trade conflict. A disciplined transmission hypothesis supported by official data and IMF surveillance; not a theory that domestic weakness produces military aggression or that every export is excess capacity.

Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
